exposure: Supervised prenatal weekly exercise session with diet advice and daily walking
Regular prenatal care with general advice on physical activity
cohort: 60 pregnant Indian women, divided into two groups, who underwent a pregnancy intervention from 20 weeks of gestation until delivery.
finding: The pregnancy lifestyle intervention significantly reduced weight retention, obesity parameters (waist, hip circumference, BMI), and pregnancy complications in Indian women.
mod_finding: The incidence of caesarean section was less in the intervention group compared to the control group.
